search_window.basis: From previous read-back verified supplementary watch heartbeat through this bounded scan. New or newly indexed reports evaluated against four specific high-value miss classes; historical and previously observed disruptions excluded.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall detection only. Nationwide production Food Line collector remains authoritative.

noteworthy_exclusions.reason: Wisconsin food-bank parking-logistics distribution cancellation reported Nov 3 and already identified in prior Food Line watch; duplicate.
Provo Community Action Services and Food Bank temporary financial closure effective Nov 1 and reported Nov 3; previously recorded Utah disruption, not new within this hourly interval.
Spencer, New York sole-grocery fire coverage was published September 14, not a new disruption.
El Paso food bank storm-damage distribution interruption dated September 23, not new.
California WIC September 3 notice reports services operating normally under federal continuing resolution; no interruption.
SNAP payment-delay coverage concerns October-November 2025, not November 2026.

coverage_notes.result: No newly verified, nonduplicative, qualifying U.S. food-access disruption within the searched interval.
coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve targeted searches completed but produced mostly historical and duplicated local reports, older November 2025 SNAP shutdown notices, and routine resource/schedule pages. Search indexing lag and unpublished local/provider updates may leave missed events; no claim of complete nationwide coverage.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approval, publication, production collector changes, schedule changes or disabling.
